clusters.headline: Parties Debate Union Cabinet Amended Delimitation Bill Proposals
aiSummaryBullets: President Droupadi Murmu has formally recommended the Delimitation (Second) Bill, 2026, for consideration in the Lok Sabha.
The proposed legislation seeks to increase the total seats in the Lok Sabha and state assemblies by 50 percent.

clusters.headline: Karthigai Deepam Lit At Thiruparankundram Following Court Mandate
aiSummaryBullets: The Karthigai Deepam was successfully lit at the Thiruparankundram hill's stone pillar under strict security protocols.
The ceremony proceeded under the oversight of two retired Madras High Court judges designated as receivers by the Supreme Court.

clusters.headline: Centre Proposes Expanding Lok Sabha Seats To 815 By Year 2051
aiSummaryBullets: The government has introduced a proposal to increase the total number of Lok Sabha seats from 543 to 815 by the year 2051.
The new plan includes a measure to freeze the proportion of seats allocated to each individual state until the 2051 deadline.

clusters.headline: Political Clash Intensifies Across India On Constitution Day
aiSummaryBullets: The BJP and Congress engaged in mutual accusations of undermining constitutional values during commemorations.
Union Minister Amit Shah criticized Congress leadership regarding the status of the Women's Reservation Bill.

clusters.headline: At Least 24 People Killed In Bus-Truck Collision In Assam State
aiSummaryBullets: A collision involving a bus and a truck occurred in Assam, India.
The incident resulted in at least 24 confirmed fatalities.

clusters.headline: Tensions Rise Between MK Stalin and TVK Following VS Babu's Death
aiSummaryBullets: Political friction between MK Stalin's DMK and Vijay's TVK has intensified following the death of MLA VS Babu.
The parties are currently in a public dispute over the proposed Delimitation Bill and the handling of the Deepam row.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Rejects Plea To Lower Minimum Election Contest Age
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court bench declined to entertain a petition requesting a lower minimum age for election candidates.
Legal counsel for the petitioner requested that authorities address the status of a prior representation regarding the matter.

clusters.headline: Sunjay Kapur Family Trust Mediation Fails In Ongoing Asset Dispute
aiSummaryBullets: Court-mandated mediation efforts to resolve the long-standing family trust dispute have concluded without an agreement.
The legal conflict involves Sunjay Kapur and centers on assets valued at approximately Rs 30,000 crore.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Orders Karthigai Deepam Lighting In Tirupparankundram
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court mandated the lighting of the ceremonial Karthigai Deepam lamp at Tirupparankundram hill.
CRPF personnel were deployed to oversee site security following the court's intervention in state administration.

clusters.headline: FSSAI Prosecutes Bisleri Over New Coliform Bacteria Findings
aiSummaryBullets: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has initiated prosecution against Bisleri after detecting coliform bacteria in samples.
Bisleri maintains that the specific West Bengal batch was recalled in August and states independent labs found the water met safety standards.

clusters.headline: Yogi Adityanath Addresses Political Criticism Following Family Loss
aiSummaryBullets: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath attended his mother's final rites in Haridwar following her passing at age 91.
The Chief Minister has engaged in verbal exchanges with political rivals, including criticism directed at the Samajwadi Party.

clusters.headline: Bombay High Court Rules Son Must Return Gifted Flat To Father
aiSummaryBullets: An 88-year-old man sought legal recourse after moving into an old-age home.
The Bombay High Court ruled that a flat previously gifted to the son must be returned.

clusters.headline: Sharad Pawar Admitted To Breach Candy Hospital In Mumbai Again
aiSummaryBullets: Sharad Pawar has been hospitalised at Breach Candy Hospital in Mumbai.
His daughter, Supriya Sule, stated that the politician is suffering from dehydration.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Quashes Case Against Rahul Gandhi Over Asset Claims
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court of India canceled Allahabad High Court directives that had requested probes by the CBI and ED into Rahul Gandhi's assets.
Rahul Gandhi recently alleged that his father, Rajiv Gandhi, had his security protection intentionally removed to facilitate his assassination.

clusters.headline: Kallakurichi TVK MLA Arul Vignesh Arrested Over Harassment Complaint
aiSummaryBullets: Kallakurichi TVK MLA Arul Vignesh was arrested by police following a harassment complaint filed by a woman IAS officer.
The case involves charges under the Tamil Nadu Prohibition of Harassment of Women Act and the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita.

clusters.headline: Deputy CM Pawan Kalyan And Anna Konidela Announce Their Separation
aiSummaryBullets: Deputy Chief Minister Pawan Kalyan and his wife Anna Konidela have officially confirmed their separation.
The announcement follows reports regarding the couple's decision to end their marriage.

clusters.headline: India Rejects US Manufacturing Claims Amid New Trade Tariff Threats
aiSummaryBullets: The United States has proposed a 25% tariff on Indian goods following a trade probe into manufacturing capacity.
Indian officials have officially denied allegations of excess manufacturing capacity in domestic sectors.

clusters.headline: India-Pakistan U19 Cricket Match Controversy Over Neutrality
aiSummaryBullets: Observers raised concerns regarding umpire conduct during the India-Pakistan match following a celebratory gesture toward the Pakistani side.
The Indian cricket team faced criticism for opting to boycott the customary post-match handshake with the Pakistani players.

clusters.headline: Nepal PM Balendra Shah Concludes First Official India Visit To Delhi
aiSummaryBullets: Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah held his first official bilateral visit to India, meeting with Prime Minister Narendra Modi in Delhi.
India committed to providing $1.6 billion in financial assistance to Nepal to support infrastructure, energy, and technology projects.

clusters.headline: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh Conducts Security Review In Sikkim
aiSummaryBullets: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh visited military bases near the China frontier to evaluate operational preparedness.
The Minister inspected infrastructure developments along the Line of Actual Control and emphasized the need for military readiness.
